meta.name: ulw-loop
meta.description: Goal-like loop that uses ultrawork mode to decompose work into systematic, evidence-bound steps.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把目标拆解成有依据的步骤并循环推进
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望按步骤推进目标并留有证据
copy.tagline_en: Break down goals into evidence-bound steps and loop them
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want step-by-step goal tracking with evidence.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会把大目标拆成细小的步骤，每一步都有明确产出并绑定证据，还会用清单跟踪进度、在需要时派子任务，确保目标被系统地完成。
howto.when: 当你说“ulw-loop”“ulw”等关键词，或要求进行有证据的长期目标执行时触发。

say.text: 用ulw-loop把我的项目拆成步骤并逐步验证
say.note: 它会创建目标清单并开始执行。

say.text: 开启ulw模式，完成这个长期任务
say.note: 请给出具体目标，避免空泛。

say.text: 用ulw-loop执行这个计划，每步都要记录证据
say.note: 它会按流程推进并更新进度。

howto.what_en: After enabling, Claude decomposes goals into granular, evidence-bound steps, tracks them via checklists, and delegates subtasks as needed.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention keywords like "ulw-loop" or "ulw", or ask for evidence-led long-running goal execution.

say_en.text: Use ulw-loop to break my project into steps and verify each one.
say_en.note: It will create a goal checklist and start executing.

say_en.text: Start ulw mode and work on this long-term task.
say_en.note: Specify a concrete goal to avoid vagueness.

say_en.text: Run ulw-loop on this plan and record evidence at every step.
say_en.note: It will proceed per workflow and update progress.
